episode_title: FYI: This is why your food is so expensive (Extractive Tapestry 6)
question: What is the CR4 ratio and why does it exceed 40% in most agricultural sectors?
transcript_excerpt: The CR4 is the combined market share of top producers in any given part of agribusiness. Most, if not all sectors of the agricultural economy are currently existing in a place where the CR4 exceeds 40% by a lot. This comes from decades of mergers and acquisitions that concentrate power within the ag sector, actively reducing market competition and allowing control over seeds, inputs, machinery, and equipment available to farmers.

episode_title: FYI: This is why your food is so expensive (Extractive Tapestry 6)
question: Which companies control the global seed market and what percentage do they represent?
transcript_excerpt: The top four global seed companies are Bayer (Monsanto), Corteva, ChemChina, and BaySaf, which make up 51% of the global seed market. These same four companies also control 62.3% of the global agrochemical market, and between 65 and 75 percent of corn, soy, and cotton seeds combined.

question: What percentage of U.S. federal farm subsidies do corn and soy account for in 2024?
transcript_excerpt: In 2024, corn accounted for 30.5% of all federal farm subsidies and soy made up another 17.9%. These were the only two subsidies that broke a billion dollars, creating incentives for farmers to grow these crops over native fruits and vegetables.

question: What major environmental incident was Dow Chemical involved in and when did it occur?
transcript_excerpt: Dow Chemical knowingly released a poison into the Tittabawasee River and covered it up with the help of the Reagan administration's deregulated EPA. To this day, they are not done cleaning it up. Dow made billions of dollars in the 1930s and were the producers of Agent Orange.

question: How many agricultural lobbyists attended COP30 by some accounts?
